evidence_status: External published inputs; not independently reconciled by Lithium. Gross fees include affiliate fees and are not captured revenue.
model_assumptions: The sampled account-volume mix represents revenue-bearing activity, which is unverified.
All exposed flow is lost after departures, with no replacement or rerouting.
Fee yield, capture fraction and price remain constant under volume changes.
Moving attribution changes assumed coverage while retaining observed within-attributed account weights.
Missing attribution can belong entirely to departing accounts or entirely elsewhere.
reuse: Numeric inputs and citation only; no code, prose or document structure copied.
unit: USD per year (annualized run rate, not realized yearly revenue)
window: Last 90 days, annualized; published rounded figures
